breaststroke in Latin

breaststroke

natātiō pectorālis

Neo-LatinDraft
  • natātiō pectorālis — breaststroke modern (Traupman 50) Traupman also gives natātiō prōna.
  • natātiō rānīna — breaststroke, “frog-style” modern also used (M-O s.v. swimming)

See also: backstroke, front crawl, swimming.

Sources & evidence

Lewis & Short: pectoralis · Lewis & Short: raninus

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. swimming; swimming: life jacket, swimming float, swimfin; swimsuit. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): pp. 50, 389.
